name: zsnd_sample_acquire_play_handle_dispatch
description: zSndSample::AcquirePlayHandleDispatch selects DirectSound or A3D voice acquisition from the active sound backend.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage shares the existing acquire-voice smoke with the backend-specific helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49f6d0 dispatches backend 0 to zSndSample::AcquireVoice, backend 1 to zSndSample::AcquireA3dVoice, and returns null for unsupported backend ids.
The native smoke verifies DirectSound, A3D, and unsupported-backend dispatch behavior.
